title: Finch Circle Points Ledger — Computing the Points Taken Back on a Refunded Return
content:
**Scope.** For a refunded return of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program this policy handles, and only for such a return, the points taken back for the returned unit are booked as one return deduction entry naming the return and the unit's purchase points entry (or its missing-points credit entry), made of the return purchase points, the return bonus event points and the return card bonus points, each taken in proportion to the refunded amount that applies to it, multiplied by the return share that applies to it and rounded half up to whole points, the sum then multiplied by the return frequency cushion and the return balance relief and rounded half up once more; no other deduction entry is booked for that return.

**Computation clause.** All entries are read from the membership's points history for the returned unit's purchase record.

1. *The unit's points.* The returned unit's purchase points are its purchase points entry plus any missing-points credit entry; its bonus event points are its bonus event points entries; its card bonus points are its card bonus entries. The qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries is that on its purchase points entry plus that on any missing-points credit entry.
2. *Return deduction.* The return deduction is the return purchase points plus the return bonus event points plus the return card bonus points, times the return frequency cushion, times the return balance relief, rounded half up to whole points.
3. *Return purchase points.* The returned unit's purchase points times the refunded qualifying amount divided by the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries, times the return exchange share, rounded half up to whole points.
4. *Return bonus event points.* The unit's bonus event points times the refunded qualifying amount divided by the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries, times the return event share, rounded half up to whole points.
5. *Return card bonus points.* The unit's card bonus points times the card refunded amount divided by the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries, rounded half up to whole points.
6. *No qualifying amount.* Each of these proportions is none (0) when the unit's purchase points entries carry no qualifying amount.
7. *Values.* The refunded qualifying amount is the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries. The card refunded amount is the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries. The return exchange share, the return event share, the return frequency cushion and the return balance relief are the whole (1).

The deduction applies even when it takes the balance below zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Purchase points entry of the unit | 240 points on a qualifying amount of 120.00 |
| Bonus event points entry | 480 points |
| Card bonus entry | 240 points |
| Return purchase points | 240 times 120.00 divided by 120.00, times 1, that is 240 |
| Return bonus event points | 480 times 120.00 divided by 120.00, times 1, that is 480 |
| Return card bonus points | 240 times 120.00 divided by 120.00, that is 240 |
| Return deduction | 240 plus 480 plus 240, that is 960, times 1, times 1: 960 points |

A unit whose purchase points entries carry no qualifying amount has proportions of none (0), so nothing is taken back on it.
